PLAN.video: How do people make millions from a financial collapse? (5-step crash plan)
PLAN.dm:
Hey {name}! Here's my 5-step crash plan 👇

1️⃣ Weak currency → digital dollars. Only fully backed stablecoins, in your own offline wallet, not on an exchange. Know the risk: issuers can freeze tokens.
2️⃣ Cash ready. A few months of expenses untouched, plus cash to buy when others are forced to sell.
3️⃣ Everyday essentials. Food, household goods, healthcare. Staples rose 24% in the 2000–02 crash.
4️⃣ AI shovels, only when cheap. Power, chips, robots. They fell 12% in one day on 5 Nov. Never buy in a panic.
5️⃣ Crypto: small slice, long term. Billion-dollar families keep ~1%.

The split framework: 25% stocks · 25% bonds · 25% gold · 25% cash. It fell ~3% in 2008 while stocks fell ~49%.

Biggest rule: don't panic-sell. People who stayed in 2008 were up 50% by 2011.

My opinion, not financial advice. Want my crash watch list too? Reply SIGNALS.

SIGNALS.video: Are we closer to the next financial collapse? (warning dashboard)
SIGNALS.dm:
Hey {name}! Here's my crash watch list 👇

These are the signals that turned past sell-offs (2000, 2008, 2020) into real crashes. I check them weekly:

1️⃣ Junk-bond spreads: the extra interest risky companies pay over US government bonds. A fast jump = credit breaking. (Search "ICE BofA US High Yield spread" on FRED.)
2️⃣ The US dollar: a sudden dollar spike = everyone rushing to cash. (DXY index.)
3️⃣ Jobless claims: US layoffs data, every Thursday. A steady rise = the economy cracking.

📅 Date I'm watching: 30 Nov, when Trump Media's $1B debt can come due.

Right now: 5 of 15 warning lights on. Jobs, banks and the dollar are still calm.

My opinion, not financial advice. Want my 5-step crash plan too? Reply PLAN.

SWAN.dm:
Hey {name}! Here's my market-crash checklist 🦢

☐ No borrowed money (no leverage). Forced selling is what wipes people out.
☐ Don't sell on a headline. Check: was it a transfer or a sale?
☐ Emergency fund outside crypto.
☐ Only hold what you could watch drop 50%.
☐ Don't keep your savings on one exchange.

Want more? Reply PLAN for my 5-step crash plan, or SIGNALS for the 3 warning signs I watch every week.

My opinion, not financial advice.
